verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a registered-agent provider, so a published flat annual price with renewal pricing stated up front is a fair question to ask of it. The pack contains no pricing evidence at all. The Wolters Kluwer host that serves every CT Corporation page returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy CT host redirects into that same blocked host, so no pricing or renewal terms could be observed. Confidence is low because this reflects blocked access rather than confirmed absence.
